name: Nasus
title: the Curator of the Sands

Q.name: Siphoning Strike
Q.description: Nasus' next Attack deals 30/50/70/90/110 + 1×AD + ? physical damage. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by 4, increased to 10 against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.
Q.summary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

W.name: Wither
W.description: Nasus ages a champion, Slowing them by 35%, increasing to 47/59/71/83/95% over 5 seconds. Their Attack Speed is also reduced by 75% of the Slow.
W.summary: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

E.name: Spirit Fire
E.description: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing 50/80/110/140/170 + 0.6×AP magic damage. Enemies in the area lose 30/35/40/45/50% Armor and take (10/16/22/28/34 + 0.12×AP) × 5 magic damage over 5 seconds.
E.summary: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

R.name: Fury of the Sands
R.description: Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by 300/450/600 and Armor and Magic Resistance by 40/55/70. While the storm rages, nearby enemies take AoeDamagePercent + 0.0×AP of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a 50% reduced Cooldown.
R.summary: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

Passive.name: Soul Eater
Passive.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.
Passive.summary: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Scaling top laner who stacks Siphoning Strike (Q) on last hits. Weak early; from level 6 and first item he wins long fights with W slow, R tankiness and huge Q hits.
strengths: Q stacks forever: one-shots late game
W slow and attack speed reduction stops kiting
R: big health and resistances, area damage
Passive lifesteal helps him sustain in lane
W: up to 95% slow plus attack speed cut ruins melee and auto-attack carries
Q cooldown drops fast with ranks, so stacks come quickly once it's maxed
weaknesses: Very weak early: bullied by most top laners
Low impact if Q stacks are denied
Mana-hungry early if he spams E

curve.lvl2: weak – W slow, but low damage
curve.items: strong – Sheen/Trinity Force (or Iceborn) for Q hits

profile.curveNote: Farms Q stacks early and gives up trades; wants R (level 6) and first item before fighting. Lost stacks = weaker all game.

Passive.notes: Bonus life steal; sustains in lane through Q last hits.

Q.notes: Empowered attack; permanent stacks on kills (dodgeable by Jax E).

W.notes: Targeted slow ramping 35%→up to 95% over 5 s; cuts attack speed by 75% of the slow. Answer to auto-attackers.

E.notes: Ground area: magic damage, armor shred while in the zone, damage over 5 s. Main wave clear.

R.notes: 15 s: bonus health, armor and magic resist; % max-health magic damage to nearby enemies; lowers Q cooldown.

profile.windowAgainst: Levels 1–5, or W on cooldown; trade on him when he walks up to last-hit with Q. Ranged laners kite him.
